_comment: The committed legal theme set of the hypothesis-authoring agent.
app_spec.xml, Hypothesis Authoring Agent, feature 212:
System rejects a proposal whose theme root falls outside the
configured legal set, which returns an illegal_theme error message.
docs/alpha-engine-prd.md 9 ('Hypothesis space (the human's job)') is
where the set comes from and why it is committed rather than computed:
'Dream-RSI improves search efficiency within a space. It cannot create
edge in a space that has none. Choosing the space is the highest-value
human input in the system, and it should be encoded as the set of legal
theme_root values.'  Section 9.3 v2 (owner-approved 2026-10-13) lists
the nine guided roots below; docs/hypothesis-space/themes-v2.md carries
the full table each entry's title, brief and the shared
construction_rules are transcribed from, so the document and this file
can be diffed against each other by eye.  v1's six (momentum/reversal,
order-flow imbalance, borrow/funding conditioning, volatility/
dispersion, calendar events, cross-venue divergence) named themes
without saying what the agent could read for them, three of them had no
data in the lake at all, and three pre-registered M2 pivots failed on
that set (docs/preregistration/*RESULT.md) - v2 replaces it rather than
widening it, so none of v1's six slugs appear below.
Section 9.4 is the neighbouring refusal and NOT this one: 'structurally
dead at retail scale' - triangular arbitrage, sub-30-minute
liquidity-taking - is feature 213's subject, and it is a different
question about a root that is already inside this set.  A theme the
human admitted and a mechanism that cannot pay for itself are two
findings, and a document that folded them together would make the
second unfixable without widening the first.
The compile in packages/signal-agent/src/signal_agent/_themes.py
refuses this file and any change to it that is not a marker plus a
list of well-formed slug/title/brief entries and a well-formed
construction_rules list - so the set below is not a convention the
next edit can forget: it is the configuration, checked, and a proposal
opening in a theme it does not name is refused with the code
illegal_theme.
The slugs are the machine spelling the node table's theme_root column
holds (docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md 9.1: 'theme_root TEXT NOT
NULL'); the titles are PRD 9.3 v2's own wording for each root, for the
human reading a rejection.  Each brief states the mechanism, the inputs
to read, the pre-registered expected sign and the notes and risks -
rendered into the authoring prompt so the agent is told what to test
rather than only where.  Widening this list is widening the hypothesis
space, which PRD 9 makes the human's own decision - the widen happens
here, in review, or not at all.
construction_rules: Score cross-sectionally. Rank or z-score within the date's universe; never raw levels.
Slow down. Use lookback windows of 7 days or more, smooth inputs (rolling means or EMAs), and aim for turnover below about 0.3 per rebalance. Weekly turnover of 0.66 erased the IC in the M2 baseline.
Missing inputs: symbols without a perpetual (15 of 100) or without enough history get the cross-sectional median score (neutral), never 0 by accident and never NaN.
State the expected sign in the mechanism, and test the stated sign. Do not flip the sign after seeing results; a flipped hypothesis is a new node.
Cast every string column to Float64. ctx.feature(..., lookback=None) and filter by symbol.

themes.title: Persistent high funding means crowded longs, which underperform

brief.mechanism: Persistently high positive funding means crowded leveraged longs paying to hold. Crowded coins underperform over the next 1-4 weeks
brief.notes: The best-documented crypto derivatives effect. Low turnover if smoothed. Spot-only book: we exploit the information, not the carry

themes.title: A wide perpetual premium over spot mean-reverts

brief.mechanism: A wide perpetual premium over spot signals speculative excess, and the premium and price mean-revert. A falling basis signals unwinding
brief.notes: Correlated with theme 1; let the tree discover which carries more

themes.title: Open interest against price; squeezes and fragile leverage

brief.mechanism: Rising open interest into a falling price means shorts are piling in, so a squeeze or reversal follows. Rising OI with a rising price is late leverage, which is fragile
brief.inputs: `metrics_1d` sum_open_interest_value 7-14d % change against the 7-14d price return; OI scaled by quote volume
brief.notes: Normalise OI by the coin's traded value, so large caps do not dominate

themes.title: Retail long/short extremes, and top traders against the crowd

brief.mechanism: Retail long/short ratio extremes are contrarian. Divergence between top traders and the global ratio means smart money disagrees with the crowd
brief.inputs: `metrics_1d` count_long_short_ratio, sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio; 7d means; top-trader minus global
brief.expected_sign: Negative on the retail ratio; positive on the top-trader-minus-retail gap

brief.mechanism: Sustained aggressive buying (the taker-buy share) reflects informed demand that keeps moving price
brief.inputs: `taker_flow_1d` taker_buy_ratio 7-14d mean, against its own 60d baseline
brief.notes: At short windows this is order-flow reversal; keep windows long for continuation

brief.mechanism: Low-volatility coins outperform on a risk-adjusted basis: lottery-seeking investors overpay for volatile ones
brief.inputs: bars: 30-90d realised volatility of daily returns; optionally idiosyncratic vol after removing a BTC beta
brief.notes: The slowest theme, so naturally low turnover. An honest 20d vol signal passed all tripwire probes on the archive snapshot 540e93 (it failed only on the short 92-day window)

brief.mechanism: Betting against beta: high-BTC-beta coins underperform after adjusting for risk
brief.inputs: bars: 60-90d rolling beta of each coin's daily return on BTC's
brief.notes: Needs BTCUSDT in the window, which it always is

brief.mechanism: Abnormal volume or trade-count spikes mark attention-driven overpricing, which unwinds over the next weeks
brief.inputs: bars: volume and trade_count over 7d against 90d (log ratio); optionally conditioned on the return over the spike
brief.notes: Liquidity proxy; keep only the persistent part (7d)

themes.title: 30-90-day momentum that skips the last week; the control

brief.mechanism: 30-90d momentum that skips the most recent 7 days, avoiding short-term reversal
brief.inputs: bars: return from t-90 to t-7 (or t-30 to t-7)
brief.notes: Historically weak and crash-prone in crypto. Keep it as the control the others must beat
